topic: Sharing files safely: who can open your link

request.notes: A hand-drawn whiteboard explainer for working adults on sharing documents from cloud storage: what each link setting lets people do (anyone with the link, people in the company, named people), view versus edit, how a link forwarded once reaches people you never meant, and the few checks to make before sharing and when access is no longer needed. Practical, calm, no fear; one marker world, simple props and people as the narration needs them.
